---
title: "Binomial to Normal Convergence"
format: html
---

## 📊 Parameter Configuration

Adjust the parameters `n` and `p` directly in the R code chunk below. Render the document to observe the changes.

```{r}
#| label: distribution-plot
#| message: false
library(ggplot2)

# ⚙️ DEFINE YOUR PARAMETERS HERE:
n <- 40
p <- 0.3

# Generate data for Binomial PMF
x_vals <-  0:(10*n*p/2)
df_bin <- data.frame(x = x_vals, pmf = dbinom(x_vals, size = n, prob = p))

# Calculate mean and standard deviation for Normal approximation
mu <- n * p
sigma <- sqrt(n * p * (1 - p))

# Render Plot
ggplot(df_bin, aes(x = x, y = pmf)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_function(
    fun = dnorm, 
    args = list(mean = mu, sd = sigma), 
    color = "firebrick", 
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Binomial vs. Normal Approximation",
    subtitle = paste("n =", n, "| p =", p, "| μ =", round(mu, 2), "| σ =", round(sigma, 2)),
    x = "Number of Successes",
    y = "Probability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
